issues.claim: First Choice Plumbing (87 Forrest St, Metuchen) website = firstchoicenj.com, phone 848-420-8120
issues.problem: firstchoicenj.com contains no Metuchen or Forrest St address and publishes 201-288-0390; its service pages are written for North Jersey. The Metuchen entity appearing on the BestProsInTown plumber/HVAC pages (87 Forrest St, 4.8/293 reviews) is a different listing whose site could not be confirmed. The mapper's own note flags the domain as unverified, so shipping it invites outreach to the wrong company.
issues.fix: Leave website blank until the 87 Forrest St operator's own domain is confirmed; replace 848-420-8120 with a number verified from a primary source.

issues.claim: Chamber 43, 406 Main St Ste 27, 'clothing store', phone 732-322-5767
issues.problem: Chamber 43 publishes chamber43.com and (732) 434-8840 and describes itself as a record shop / music creative space with a private appointment-only office; vintage apparel is bought, not retailed as a clothing store. The phone and category in the list do not match.
issues.fix: Change category to 'record shop / music retail-cum-office', use 732-434-8840 and chamber43.com, and note the appointment-only, possibly home-office nature.

issues.claim: Flood Damage Pro, town = Metuchen, address 'Unknown'

issues.claim: Excluded types still listed: Apple Montessori School (12 Center St), Kinder Kastle Childcare (740 Middlesex Ave), Cross Country Powersports (911 Middlesex Ave), Autoteam Car Rental (341 Amboy Ave)
issues.problem: Apple Montessori is a multi-campus NJ school group and a school type (excluded twice over); Kinder Kastle runs six NJ childcare centres (chain); Cross Country Powersports is a multi-brand franchised new-vehicle dealership (Honda, Suzuki, Kawasaki, Triumph, Polaris, Can-Am, Royal Enfield); Autoteam is a multi-location NJ rental brand. All four were flagged as borderline by the mapper but left in the list.
issues.fix: Apply the chain/franchise and school exclusions and remove all four, or ask the brief's owner for an explicit exception before outreach.

issues.problem: The Downtown Metuchen listing for Newmarket publishes no phone; 732-351-2550 is the directory number of Creative Twist Events (10 Pearl St), which the list also carries. One of the two phones is wrong or the businesses share an owner.
issues.fix: Blank the Newmarket phone and note the possible shared operator with Creative Twist Events.

issues.claim: Duplicate-premises clusters: 913 Middlesex Ave (Bulldog Auto, Raymond's Autobody, Wizard Auto Body, Satch Cycles), 99 Middlesex Ave (Beacon Hill, B&H Auto), 10 Liberty St (Auto Motion, Jeff's Auto Body), 159 Liberty St (C&K Plastics, Valley Extrusions), 25 Adams St (Electrical Construction, Salson's Wholesale)
issues.problem: Four or more 'separate' shops on one yard/one suite may be one operator or one address used by mobile businesses; the list already flags two of these but counts each as a separate lead.
issues.fix: De-duplicate by phone/owner before outreach so the team does not pitch the same firm four times at 913 Middlesex Ave.

issues.claim: Coverage: 5 eligible Metuchen businesses found in independent searches are absent from the list
issues.problem: V&F Auto Body (20 Prospect St, own website), Big G Movers (26 Oliver St, own website), Jimmy's PowerWashing (Metuchen-based, own website), Artvisa Corp (212 Durham Ave framing) and Sterling Key & Lock Works (16 Pearl St) are missing; 11 of 16 eligible businesses surfaced were already listed (~69%), below the 70% bar.
issues.fix: Add the five missing businesses (at minimum V&F Auto Body, Big G Movers and Jimmy's PowerWashing, which are confirmed on their own sites).

issues.claim: Several entries carry Metuchen towns on the strength of a Google-Maps-only listing (Dirtbusters 75 Essex Ave, Hello Maid 93 Center St, Sierra's Gifts, Chamber 43, Carpet Maven II 137 Main St)
issues.problem: Some were later verified (Dirtbusters publishes 75 Essex Ave, Metuchen and its own site dirtbustersnj.com — website field left blank), others were not (Hello Maid, Sierra's Gifts). Grouping map-only addresses as Metuchen without confirmation mixed two very different confidence levels in one list.
issues.fix: Re-check each map-only address; fill Dirtbusters' website; mark or drop the unconfirmed ones.
